caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a long, 18th-century style dress. The dress is primarily off-white or cream in color and features elaborate floral patterns in shades of red, blue, and green across the outer sections, including the bodice, sleeves, and the side areas of the skirt. The frock has a fitted bodice with lacing at the front, off-the-shoulder short sleeves adorned with sheer ruffled cuffs, and an elongated, slightly flared skirt. The central part of the skirt is a lighter cream color with subtle decorative embroidery, contrasting with the more colorful floral patterned fabric on the sides. The neckline is wide and trimmed with a delicate ruffle. The background is plain and unadorned, focusing attention solely on the dress.
title: Dress with Quilted Petticoat
